why: Newbook engine (bookingsus.newbook.cloud/sparrowpond, read 2026-10-21) sells no RV night shorter than 3: every RV category (W&E 20/30, Shaded FHU, Back In FHU, Pull Thru FHU, Pond Site) shows 'Standard ... 3 Night min - extend' for 1- and 2-night quotes on Tue 2027-05-11, 06-15, 07-13, 09-14, 10-05 and Sun 2027-08-15, and books only from 3 nights (06-15..06-18); a standing 3-night minimum outside holidays fails long-stay test 3.
name: Sparrow Pond Family Campground
flags: Conflict to weigh: the operator's rates page (sparrowpond.com/rv-sites, read 2026-10-21) prices weekday (Sun-Thu, from $70 W&E / $75-80 FHU) and weekend (Fri-Sat) nights and names a 3-night minimum only under HOLIDAY rates, which reads as if single nights sell. The engine says otherwise for all of 2027; 2026 could not be tested (season Apr 19 - Oct 27, no sites online for the remaining Oct 2026 dates). Engine quotes are 2027 only, so this may be an advance-booking rule; no phone or walk-up waiver is published. If a call confirmed single weeknights sell, it would otherwise pass: real transient park, 84 bookable RV sites to 45 ft (Outdoorsy listing) against a seasonal section (red on the 2025 site map, seasonal via a waitlist), price gate lifted within 40 km of a family home (gateways.py).
Engine Standard rates 2027 (pre-tax, 1 adult): W&E 20/30 $69.61, Back In FHU $76.47, Shaded FHU $78.55, Pull Thru / Pond Site $81.93; Weekly (7-night) tariffs lower.

Waterfront not audited (skip). Lead if revived: 'Pond Site' category, sites P151-P167 face a small catch-and-release fishing pond on the 2025 site map (sparrowpond.com/app/uploads/2025/05/SPC-Site-Map-WEB-05052025.png).
